requirements.title: MASKR argument restrictions
requirements.definition: I shall be integer, nonnegative, and no greater than the number of bits z of the integer bit model for the result kind; optional KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

pending.MASKR-I-integer: Positive source controls call MASKR with integer I values 0, 1, 3, and BIT_SIZE(0); a source-control mutation uses a noninteger I and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.MASKR-I-nonnegative-and-at-most-z: Positive source controls call MASKR with I=0, I=1, and I=BIT_SIZE(0); source-control mutations use I=-1 and I=BIT_SIZE(0)+1 and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MASKR-KIND-scalar-integer-constant-expre: Positive source control calls MASKR with KIND=KIND(0); source-control mutations use a noninteger or nonconstant KIND expression and claim no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: MASKR result type and kind follow KIND presence or default integer
requirements.definition: The MASKR result is integer; with KIND present its kind type parameter is the value of KIND, and with KIND absent its kind type parameter is default integer.

pending.MASKR-result-integer-type: Assign MASKR(1) to an integer variable and assert POPCNT plus BTEST bit observations from the bit-result facet; mutate the intrinsic to a logical-valued control in source review, not as a diagnostic facet.
pending.MASKR-result-kind-from-KIND: Probe for a nondefault integer kind via SELECTED_INT_KIND; upon a positive kind value, evaluate MASKR(1,KIND=that_kind), assert KIND(...) equals that kind, and mutate KIND to KIND(0) so the kind check fails. The default-kind control exercises KIND presence on processors lacking another kind.
pending.MASKR-result-default-kind-absent: Evaluate MASKR(1) and assert KIND(...) equals KIND(0); companion MASKR(1,KIND=KIND(0)) guards against an absent-call parser special case.

requirements.title: MASKR sets the rightmost I bits in bit context
requirements.definition: The MASKR result has its rightmost I bits set to 1 and all remaining bits set to 0 under the 16.3 integer bit model.

pending.MASKR-zero-right-bits-all-zero: Use I=0 with a nonvacuous I=1 companion; assert POPCNT(MASKR(0))==0 and POPCNT(MASKR(1))==1, never the numeric value of a sign-bit result. Mutate I=0 to I=1 so the zero-width case fails.
pending.MASKR-rightmost-I-bits-set: For z=BIT_SIZE(0), compute R=MASKR(3), assert BTEST(R,0), BTEST(R,1), and BTEST(R,2) are true and POPCNT(R)==3; mutate MASKR to MASKL so the rightmost-bit checks fail.
pending.MASKR-remaining-bits-zero: For R=MASKR(3), assert BTEST(R,3) and BTEST(R,z-1) are false for z greater than 3, paired with the three true rightmost checks; mutate I to z so the remaining-bit checks fail.
pending.MASKR-full-width-all-bits-set: Use I=BIT_SIZE(0), assert POPCNT(MASKR(I))==I plus BTEST at positions 0 and I-1 are true, and compare only bit-context observations; mutate I to I-1 so one selected bit or count check fails.
